# komodo_stack (Data Source)

Fetches a Komodo stack by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "komodo_stack" "web" {
  id = "web-app" # ID or display name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Stack ID or name.

### Read-Only

- `branch` (String)
- `git_provider` (String)
- `ignore_services` (List of String) Services excluded from stack health status checks.
- `linked_repo` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `project_name` (String)
- `repo` (String)
- `server_id` (String)
- `swarm_id` (String)
